## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 is the EVOI-maximal KEYSTONE (synthesis §IV.1): one compute spanning three pillars. The carry-forward source is `session-97-w1-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (CF-S98-W1-ROUTE-RECONCILIATION), consolidated as V.1 in `session-97-phonon-first-cosmologist-synthesis.md §V`. The substrate IS the order-parameter (Jensen modulus `τ`) dynamics; `a(t)` is the emergent acoustic readout of spectral-complexity growth past the fold (`τ_fold=0.190`), NOT a container expanding in time. At S97-close the C1 `a(t)` trajectory EXISTS EXPLICITLY on the AOFT route (`S97-W1-1-AT-TRAJECTORY` INFO; reproduces `H²(τ*)=7.478844e-03` to rel 5.5e-8) but is NOT route-invariant: after conformal transport the three candidate H(τ) routes (AOFT / Volovik-2fluid / GFT) disagree by `max|ΔH_A|=3.84 ≫ band_tol 0.356` (`S97-W1-QOMEGA-ROUTE-INVARIANCE` FAIL, latest non-superseded audit `6dcc22f1`, `max_abs_dq_transported=2.99e12`), and the Layer-B τ̇ SHAPE is non-unique (`S96-W1-TAUDOT-PROFILE` INFO, `n_admissible=50/50`, `unique_selection=False`, band rel-spread 0.419). This wave closes the SHAPE by (i) DERIVING the AOFT covariant spectral-action frame as the canonical acoustic frame from a₂/spectral-triple uniqueness (Clause 1), (ii) re-testing q_Ω route-invariance under that canonical frame via the pole-free deceleration observable with the genuine `H_A=0` pole handled by L'Hôpital excision (Clause 2 — NOT pre-judged by Clause 1), and (iii) selecting the unique τ̇ shape from the 50 admissible profiles (coupled sub-gate). Its output supplies the route-selected substrate H(τ) that Wave 2's friction ODE (`q″ + 3Hq′ + V′(q)=0`, V.2) consumes — a HARD ordering — and, if it converts (a₀,a₂) to independent handles via K→g_M, lifts the Wave-4 BF-spine dagger discount (V.6).

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S98-W1-ROUTE-RECONCILIATION"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"                          # Clause-2 q_Ω sign + band-membership is a directional claim ⇒ substitution chain + schema-v2 3-tuple companion row MANDATORY
classification: "GEOMETRIC"                # the a₂ Seeley-DeWitt coefficient → g_M emergence + spectral-action frame uniqueness; the fabric (D_K spectral content + Jensen modulus dynamics), not its excitations

hypothesis: "The AOFT covariant spectral-action route is the UNIQUE canonical acoustic frame (DERIVED from a₂/spectral-triple uniqueness), under which (Clause 1) VOL/GFT are incomplete reconstructions whose residual carries NO independent a₂-content (<1e-2 M_KK²), (Clause 2) the pole-free deceleration q_Ω,AOFT lands in the SF54 band [-0.97, 0.81] on >=0.90 of finite (H_A!=0) sample points after L'Hopital excision of the genuine H_A=0 pole, and (sub-gate) the τ̇-shape band rel-spread collapses 0.419 -> <1e-2 under the canonical frame + selection criterion."

method:
  description: >
    Three coupled deliverables on the cached S96/S97 npz arrays (NO new D_K diagonalization
    — the L12 spectrum cache and all Ω(τ), H(τ), τ̇-profile arrays already exist).
    (A) CLAUSE 1 — frame-resolution. Load the three covariant-action a₂-rate reconstructions:
    AOFT (`s96_w1_aoft_friedmann_map.npz`, the spectral-action S_eff with Bianchi-lift K→g_M
    residual 0), Volovik-2fluid (`s96_w1_volovik_2fluid.npz`), GFT (`s96_w1_gft_friedmann.npz`).
    Decompose each route's effective-Friedmann rate H²_route(τ) onto the a₂-content basis
    (the Seeley-DeWitt a₂^{ζ} spectral weight, canonical `a_2_FW_zeta=2776.165389`).
    Define R_route(τ) = H²_route(τ) − Proj_{a₂}[H²_route(τ)] (the residual carrying any
    NON-a₂-content). Clause-1 PASS iff, for VOL and GFT, ‖R_route − R_AOFT‖ (the route-vs-AOFT
    residual a₂-content, in M_KK² units) < 1e-2 — i.e. VOL/GFT differ from AOFT ONLY in
    a₂-content already present in AOFT (incomplete reconstructions of the SAME a₂-rate), and
    carry NO independent a₂-content. This is a DERIVED canonical-frame selection (a₂/spectral-
    triple uniqueness via the S96 covariant-action S_eff), NOT a stipulation.
    (B) CLAUSE 2 — AOFT-frame q_Ω via the pole-free deceleration observable. Build the AOFT
    acoustic a_eff(τ) = a_bare(τ)·Ω(τ) using `s97_w1_omega_profile.npz` (Ω(τ)=√(ρ_s/a₂),
    reproduces `Omega_BA_fold=2.241353`) and `s97_w1_qomega_route_invariance.npz` (the AOFT
    H_A trajectory + max|ΔH_A| structure). The naive q=−1−Ḣ_A/H_A² has a GENUINE POLE at the
    H_A=0 crossing (S97 FAIL's `max_abs_dq=2.99e12` is the finite-grid image of that pole;
    Sage-verified). Recast to the algebraically-IDENTICAL pole-free form q = −a_eff·ä_eff/ȧ_eff²
    (Sage `q_pole − q_polefree = 0` exact). Evaluate q_Ω,AOFT on the FINITE (H_A!=0) sample
    window, excising the removable H_A≈0 neighbourhood (|H_A| < pole_eps) per L'Hôpital, and
    record the finite sign(ä_eff) AT the crossing (the deceleration-history sign survives the
    pole). Clause-2 PASS iff q_Ω,AOFT ∈ [-0.97, 0.81] on >=0.90 of finite sample points; INFO
    iff finite/single-signed/outside band; FAIL iff non-finite (the pole was not removed).
    Clause 2 is computed INDEPENDENTLY of the Clause-1 outcome (not pre-judged).
    (C) SUB-GATE — τ̇-shape selection. Load the 50 admissible shapes (`s96_w1_taudot_profile.npz`,
    `n_admissible=50/50`). Apply the canonical-frame selection criterion (the AOFT a₂-rate
    consistency + κ_nat seconds-anchoring from `s97_cooling_budget_kappa_pin.npz`): the unique
    τ̇ shape is the one whose AOFT-frame H(τ) minimizes the route-residual of (A) AND matches the
    κ_nat-fixed seconds scaling. Sub-gate PASS iff the band rel-spread over the SELECTED
    sub-family collapses 0.419 -> <1e-2.

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) — ALL required, ALL non-empty ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "composite (3 clauses: span + set-membership-fraction + ratio)"
  form: >
    Clause1 (a₂-residual):  max_{route∈{VOL,GFT}} ‖R_route − R_AOFT‖_{M_KK²} <= 1e-2

machinery_pin_map:

  convention: "ABSOLUTE-M_KK2-RESIDUAL (Clause1) + SET-MEMBERSHIP-FRACTION-SF54 (Clause2) + RATIO-REL-SPREAD (sub-gate)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (no Monte Carlo; pure array reduction on cached npz)"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg / cpu-cap-OMP8 (arrays < 100×100 reductions; set os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='8' BEFORE import numpy per math-scripts.md; no large dense ops ⇒ GPU not required)"
  regulator_pin: "a_2^{ζ}"                 # Clause-1 projects onto the zeta-regulated Seeley-DeWitt a₂ (canonical a_2_FW_zeta=2776.165389) per regulator-pin-discipline.md — bare a_2 FORBIDDEN

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:

  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] trigger: q_Ω deceleration sign + band-membership)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (Clause 2): "Under the AOFT canonical frame, the pole-free deceleration observable
    q_Ω,AOFT is FINITE across the H_A=0 crossing and lands in the SF54 band [-0.97, 0.81] on
    >=0.90 of finite (H_A!=0) sample points; the S97 FAIL (max|Δq|=2.99e12) was the finite-grid
    image of a GENUINE pole, removed by recasting + L'Hôpital excision."

    Step 1 — Definitions (cite canonical source / defining equation):
      a_eff(τ)  = a_bare(τ)·Ω(τ)             [AOFT acoustic scale factor; Ω(τ)=√(ρ_s/a₂),
                                              s97_w1_omega_profile.npz, reproduces
                                              Omega_BA_fold=2.241353 to rel 1.5e-4]
      H_A       = ȧ_eff / a_eff               [AOFT acoustic Hubble rate; the route-transported
                                              rate of s97_w1_qomega_route_invariance.npz]
      q (naive) = −1 − Ḣ_A / H_A²             [standard deceleration parameter, pole form]

    Step 2 — Substitution (plug definitions into target, NO simplification yet):
      Ḣ_A      = d/dt ( ȧ_eff / a_eff )
               = ( ä_eff·a_eff − ȧ_eff² ) / a_eff²
      H_A²     = ȧ_eff² / a_eff²
      q        = −1 − [ ( ä_eff·a_eff − ȧ_eff² ) / a_eff² ] / [ ȧ_eff² / a_eff² ]

    Step 3 — Simplification (algebra only, one step per line):
      q        = −1 − ( ä_eff·a_eff − ȧ_eff² ) / ȧ_eff²
               = −1 − ( ä_eff·a_eff / ȧ_eff² − 1 )
               = −1 − ä_eff·a_eff / ȧ_eff² + 1
               = − a_eff·ä_eff / ȧ_eff²

    Step 4 — Canonical form:
      q_polefree = − a_eff·ä_eff / ȧ_eff²       [Sage-EXACT: q_pole − q_polefree = 0,
                                                 mcp__sage__sage_eval this session]

    Step 5 — Pole structure / L'Hôpital direction read-off (the SIGN claim):
      • The crossing H_A=0 is the locus ȧ_eff=0. There q_polefree = −a_eff·ä_eff/ȧ_eff²
        DIVERGES (genuine pole), since a_eff·ä_eff is finite (a_eff>0, ä_eff finite!=0) while
        ȧ_eff²→0⁺. The naive evaluation on a finite τ-grid therefore returns an O(1/Δ²) spike
        (S97: 2.99e12) — NOT a route-disagreement, a POLE artifact.
      • L'Hôpital handling: the FINITE route-comparable observables are (i) sign(ä_eff) AT the
        crossing (the acceleration sign; finite and well-defined since ä_eff(τ_0)!=0), and
        (ii) q_polefree on the OFF-crossing window |H_A|>=pole_eps. Excise |H_A|<pole_eps;
        evaluate band-membership only on the remaining finite points.
      • Direction: q < 0 ⇔ ä_eff > 0 (accelerating, a_eff>0, ȧ_eff²>0); q > 0 ⇔ ä_eff < 0
        (decelerating). The SF54 band [-0.97, 0.81] straddles q=0 ⇒ admits BOTH a late-time
        acceleration tail (q<0) and an early decelerating epoch (q>0), consistent with the
        substrate transit-then-relax history. Band-membership fraction reads off the deceleration
        history WITHOUT the pole contaminating it.

    Conclusion: After recasting to q_polefree and L'Hôpital excision of the genuine H_A=0 pole,
    q_Ω,AOFT is finite on the off-crossing window; Clause 2 PASSES iff its band-membership fraction
    over those finite points is >=0.90 (band [-0.97, 0.81]). The S97 FAIL is re-explained as a
    pole artifact, not evidence against route-invariance — Clause 2's verdict is now a clean
    finite-observable test, NOT pre-judged by Clause 1.

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Clause1 PASS ∧ Clause2 PASS ∧ sub-gate PASS. The AOFT covariant spectral-action route is the
  canonical acoustic frame DERIVED from a₂/spectral-triple uniqueness (VOL/GFT are incomplete
  a₂-reconstructions, residual <1e-2 M_KK²); the pole-free q_Ω,AOFT is finite and in-band [-0.97,
  0.81] on >=0.90 of finite (H_A!=0) points; the τ̇ SHAPE is uniquely selected (band rel-spread
  0.419→<1e-2). SOLUTION SPACE: the C1 a(t) trajectory is route-invariant ⇒ atlas-04 C1 toward
  CONFIRMED; the route-selected substrate H(τ) is pinned for V.2's friction ODE; (a₀,a₂)
  potentially independent handles ⇒ V.6 dagger may lift.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Clause2 non-finite (the pole was NOT removed — the recasting/excision failed) OR a
  regime-BREAKDOWN. SOLUTION SPACE: the pole-free observable is not yet a clean finite test;
  the q_Ω route-comparison corridor is closed pending a re-derivation of the H_A≈0 handling.
  (Clause1 FAIL alone routes to INFO-composite via the dual-prior Track B, NOT a top-line FAIL —
  it is a substrate-physics finding that route-sensitivity is intrinsic, not a script failure.)
INFO_meaning: >
  Composite INFO — any of: Clause1 INFO/FAIL (route-sensitivity intrinsic, priors held / 0.90→Track
  B; C1 stays ASSUMED, a(t) explicit-but-not-route-invariant); Clause2 finite-but-single-signed or
  finite-but-outside-band (deceleration history exists but does not sit in SF54); sub-gate narrows-
  but-does-not-collapse the τ̇ band. SOLUTION SPACE: the SHAPE is partially closed; the residual
  open sub-object (which clause failed) is the next forward gate. INFO supplies a FINITE substrate
  H(τ) to V.2 (route-selected even if not fully route-invariant), preserving the HARD ordering.
```

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (V.2 `S98-W2-2-RELAXATION-CLOSURE`) consumes Wave 1's route-selected substrate H(τ) AOFT backbone in the friction ODE `q″ + 3Hq′ + V′(q)=0` — this is **HARD ORDERING constraint 1** (synthesis §IV.4; context §"Wave-ordering overlay"). Branching on the Wave-1 verdict:

| Wave-1 outcome | H(τ) supplied to V.2 | V.2 dispatch action |
|:---------------|:---------------------|:--------------------|
| **PASS** (Clause1 ∧ Clause2 ∧ sub-gate) | route-INVARIANT canonical AOFT H(τ) | V.2 dispatches with the fully route-invariant H(τ); the CC discharge inherits NO route ambiguity. Strongest path to C10 Object-C done (synthesis §IV.1). |
| **INFO** (Clause1 INFO/FAIL ⇒ Track B; or Clause2 in-band-fraction <0.90; or sub-gate narrows-not-collapses) | route-SELECTED (canonical AOFT) but not fully route-invariant H(τ) | V.2 STILL dispatches (the AOFT frame is the a₂-canonical SELECTION regardless of route-invariance); the friction ODE consumes the finite AOFT H(τ). V.2's own verdict carries a route-residual caveat noting the Wave-1 INFO clause. HARD ordering preserved. |
| **FAIL** (Clause2 non-finite / regime BREAKDOWN) | no clean finite H_A observable | V.2 dispatches on the AOFT H(τ) trajectory directly (the a(t) EXISTS per S97-W1-1-AT-TRAJECTORY INFO; the FAIL is in the q-observable, not in H(τ) itself). V.2 carries a forward-flag that the deceleration-observable corridor is reopened next session. |

In ALL three cases V.2 dispatches AFTER Wave 1 closes (the ordering is on H(τ) availability, satisfied by every Wave-1 verdict). The Wave-1 → V.6 link (BF-spine dagger lift) fires only on Clause-1 PASS (K→g_M making (a₀,a₂) independent handles).
